summary: 16 of 26 sub-steps present. The plan covers the bank-exchange network (B1-B4), the phase interface (P1-P4), the label totals (L3-L5), the rank-saving inequalities (R1, R4), the one-interchange shear (M4) and the depth recurrence and final truncation (S2, S5). It omits the residual table and the side edge 2 to 5 (L1, L2), the explicit eta values (R2, R3), the matrix-shear lemma's elimination proof, prime choice and descending-order triangular cost (M1-M3), and the guard-width constants, unrolling and bit-width argument (S1, S3, S4).
